div.style: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;

width: 38px; height: 38px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38bdf8, #7e22ce); border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 3px; width: 22px; height: 22px;

span.style: font-size: 0.45rem; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
